title: Knowledge Atlas for AI and Software Engineering
author: Enrico Papalini
bio: Enrico Papalini is a software engineering leader and author based in Milan, Italy. With more than 25 years in software engineering and 15 in people management, his work focuses on AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and dependable financial-market systems. His career includes leadership roles at Euronext Securities, London Stock Exchange Group and Borsa Italiana. He writes the Non-Deterministic series and created this independent knowledge atlas.
bio_note: Adapted from the author biography in Non-Deterministic Loop Engineering. This is an independent author project; the views expressed do not represent Euronext or any other institution.

collections.title: SE@PoliMi bibliography
collections.description: 229 research records discovered through Software Engineering @ PoliMi: the original 193-work snapshot plus 36 reviewed additions in this release. Original research authors, publication status, inspection scope and evidence limitations remain explicit. Summaries are independent atlas annotations.

collections.title: Addy Osmani
collections.description: 62 reviewed Addy Osmani records. Source arguments and independent evidence remain distinct.

collections.title: The Pragmatic Engineer
collections.description: 127 written Pragmatic Engineer records. Blog and Deepdives are deduplicated; The Pulse title-prefix and podcast exclusions remain in force.

collections.title: Martin Fowler’s website
collections.description: 41 records on Martin Fowler’s website, retaining actual bylines, publication and revision dates, and explicit series or adjacent-site scope.

collections.title: Earlier Non-Deterministic books
collections.description: 111 informative chapter/file records from five earlier volumes by Enrico Papalini. These are source-genealogy and editorial records, not 111 independent research studies. Original English and Italian catalogue wording is retained.

collections.title: NDSE2 · Published second edition
collections.description: 13 chapters from the published Non-Deterministic Software Engineering, Second Edition. English and Italian titles, section outlines and literal source citations are reconciled to the author-supplied final 13.7.1 sources.

collections.title: Software Engineering Practices
collections.description: 84 English operational guides in 12 families: when to use a practice, how to apply it, illustrative examples, verification, outputs and limitations. Historical source occurrences remain traceable.

sources.method: Reconcile the November bulletin against the pinned 193-record W collection; check primary sources and identity aliases; inspect current publication/version metadata.

limitations: The discovery set is the bulletin published 4 November 2026, covering changes through 1 November. Primary-source metadata was checked on 6 November; this is not a claim of exhaustive worldwide research coverage through that date.

Nineteen new records were checked at primary-abstract level. The remaining 17 have primary text, selected manuscript sections or a primary report page checked. Scope is recorded on each entry; no experimental or statistical results were independently replicated.
Accepted manuscripts, working papers, research reports and opinion remain distinct from published peer-reviewed articles. The CACM opinion has no new empirical evaluation.
Alanazi et al. report internally inconsistent task-time statistics. This unresolved reporting issue is disclosed; the atlas does not repair the values or repeat a significant time-saving conclusion.

Historical graph assertions and source-audit fields are retained. Current correction and classification fields identify revised interpretations; new chapter links are reading suggestions rather than additions to the published manuscript.

sources.method: Review the ten-item blog feed, all 24 current blog-index cards, official newsletter archive and 2026 sitemap; inspect distinct articles and paired mirrors.
sources.outcome: 11 older omissions added; no new eligible publication after 18 October; 13 blog/newsletter mirrors retain existing IDs.
limitations: The newsletter feed returned HTML instead of RSS; the official archive and annual sitemap supplied alternative coverage.
No complete historical body snapshots exist to detect every silent edit. The older backfill was bounded to the current index.

sources.method: Cross-check newsletter and blog feeds, current archive, individual primary pages and sitemap activity; resolve every observed format and identity.
sources.outcome: 3 new written articles added; podcasts, Pulse issues and announcements excluded. Timestamp-only activity on existing articles is logged without asserting revised findings.
limitations: P125 and P126 were inspected only through their public previews; subscriber-only text was not accessed.
The static Deepdives index exposed no article links; feeds, archive and article metadata supplied alternative coverage. Silent edits cannot be exhaustively detected.

sources.method: Review official Atom feed, recent changes, every series-index entry and complete primary text for included adjacent-site articles; retain actual bylines.
sources.outcome: 2 new articles and 4 older omissions added. All 33 Exploring Generative AI series entries were already represented; the six additions are adjacent-site sources.
limitations: This bounded review does not claim an exhaustive site-wide archive audit or detection of every silent historical edit.
Linked experiments, external statistics and illustrative code were not independently replicated.
